descriptionMarkdown:
An updatede version of my Diamond block mega block fitted for space age, the old one:
[Diamond block mega base](https://factorioprints.com/view/-Nj2RfFYhe4FpfnR669d).

This book contains also a warning system like the old one but also an information hub over the different planets and it resourses ( this must be put in manually because the [Holographic Signs mod](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/holographic_signs?from=search) cannot save the input showns in the picture on - [Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/factorio/comments/1m6p0a3/space_age_diamond_mega_block_designs_i_want_to/) )
The hub also tell how many robots and robotports there is in the network and also a translation for the virtual signals each block has for showning the correct amount in the dashboard.

It also have and indicator in the warning system that shows how many trains and stations each of the items has for an easier way to check if there is room for more trains.

Mod used: 
- [Nixie Tubes](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/nixie-tubes?from=search)
- [Text Plates](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/textplates?from=search)
- [Loaders modernized](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/loaders-modernized)
- [AAI Containers & Warehouses](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/aai-containers?from=search)
- [AAI Signal Transmission](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/aai-signal-transmission?from=search)
- [Virtual Signals 2](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/virtual-signals2)
- [Holographic Signs mod](https://mods.factorio.com/mod/holographic_signs?from=search)


More pictures - [here](https://www.reddit.com/r/factorio/comments/1m6p0a3/space_age_diamond_mega_block_designs_i_want_to/)
